scope: Actual temporary SQLite, shared quote policy, actual route guards/router; synthetic identities/session boundary and intercepted transport only.

tests.name: Default paid proposal is centralized, bounded and has no real provider cost
Strict policy parser rejects model/provider overrides, unknown keys and invalid factors
Permille arithmetic rounds up source/video chunks and separates teaching tasks
Reading proposal/admin aliases does not seed policy or mutate any wallet
Paid policy CAS changes only paid settings and audit; all financial rows and Free/Plus stay equal
Free/Plus reservations keep original rate formula, return shape and null policy snapshot
Paid reservation stores immutable quote/model snapshot and settles original units after config changes
Paid refund is owner bound, once only, and restores held amount without repricing
Generic client input cannot inject trusted paid model or teaching context
Configured alias snapshot rejects environment model changes before any paid dispatch
A new unlisted fallback never dispatches after an existing primary failure
An allowlisted fallback retains existing bounded routing without additional policy charge
Admin policy API enforces guest, recent authentication, canonical account and origin
Quote endpoint is account-bound and read-only, and rejects forged price/model fields
Actual learner handler measures source text instead of forged quote/sourceCharacters
Actual learner handler refuses Premium deep before transport and keeps plan unchanged
Actual Pro learner deep uses configured server alias and exact quoted units
Genuine schema19 upgrade preserves existing account/ledger/reservation fields and creates no grants
Paid proposal never enables checkout, renewals or teacher/class authority
Legacy catalog HTTP cannot bypass paid strict bounds, Pro inheritance or revision/reason CAS
Out-of-range historical paid catalog overlay fails closed rather than becoming a trusted policy

limitations: No merchant, payment lifecycle, actual provider pricing/invoice/profit or paid entitlement sale.
No real user migration; source-only migration20 is independently covered by focused fixture checks.
Teacher permissions are independent of paid plans.
